crossRefs.note: Do you have faith? Have it to yourself before God. Happy is he who doesn’t judge himself in that which he approves.
So you testify and consent to the works of your fathers. For they killed them, and you build their tombs.
For Yahweh knows the way of the righteous, but the way of the wicked shall perish.
Yahweh is good, a stronghold in the day of trouble; and he knows those who take refuge in him.
However God’s firm foundation stands, having this seal, “The Lord knows those who are his,” and, “Let every one who…
But if what I don’t desire, that I do, I consent to the law that it is good.
For the good which I desire, I don’t do; but the evil which I don’t desire, that I practice.
But if what I don’t desire, that I do, it is no more I that do it, but sin which dwells in me.
If they sin against you (for there is no man who doesn’t sin), and you are angry with them, and deliver them to the…
Who can discern his errors? Forgive me from hidden errors.
Sins overwhelmed me, but you atoned for our transgressions.
Blessed are those whose ways are blameless, who walk according to Yahweh’s law.
I run in the path of your commandments, for you have set my heart free.
Behold, I long for your precepts! Revive me in your righteousness.
Surely there is not a righteous man on earth who does good and doesn’t sin.
For the flesh lusts against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh; and these are contrary to one another, that…
Not that I have already obtained, or am already made perfect; but I press on, that I may take hold of that for which…
For we all stumble in many things. Anyone who doesn’t stumble in word is a perfect person, able to bridle the whole…
But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus Christ…
If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.
Let love be without hypocrisy. Abhor that which is evil. Cling to that which is good.
He plots iniquity on his bed. He sets himself in a way that is not good. He doesn’t abhor evil.
You who love Yahweh, hate evil! He preserves the souls of his saints. He delivers them out of the hand of the wicked.
I will set no vile thing before my eyes. I hate the deeds of faithless men. They will not cling to me.
Through your precepts, I get understanding; therefore I hate every false way.
I hate double-minded men, but I love your law.
Therefore I consider all of your precepts to be right. I hate every false way.
I hate and abhor falsehood. I love your law.
The fear of Yahweh is to hate evil. I hate pride, arrogance, the evil way, and the perverse mouth.
A righteous man hates lies, but a wicked man brings shame and disgrace.
Hate evil, love good, and establish justice in the courts. It may be that Yahweh, the God of Armies, will be gracious…
You have loved righteousness and hated iniquity; therefore God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of gladness…
and some save, snatching them out of the fire with fear, hating even the clothing stained by the flesh.

translations.web: For I don’t know what I am doing. For I don’t practice what I desire to do; but what I hate, that I do.
translations.bsb: I do not understand what I do. For what I want to do, I do not do. But what I hate, I do.
translations.kjv: For that which I do I allow not: for what I would, that do I not; but what I hate, that do I.
translations.asv: For that which I do I know not: for not what I would, that do I practise; but what I hate, that I do.
